key: runtime segment $03B5E0-$03ED50 (ext):0:2E90
name: poll_counter_and_recurse
description: Calls an unnamed routine when a shared counter equals its maximum, and loops calling it while a comparison of that same variable holds. The recovered comparisons test a variable against itself, so the loop structure is unreliable and the purpose is not clear from this code alone.

key: runtime segment $03B5E0-$03ED50 (ext):0:2EB4
name: repeat_call_until_compare
description: Calls an unnamed routine inside an endless loop that exits only on a self-comparison of a shared variable. The decompiled control flow is degenerate, so only the single call is reliable.

key: runtime segment $03B5E0-$03ED50 (ext):0:2EB8
name: return_immediately_noop
description: Does nothing except return at once, so it changes no memory or registers.

key: runtime segment $03B5E0-$03ED50 (ext):0:2EBA
name: pulse_port_until_flag_clears
description: Writes a low-then-high pair of byte values to the CIA port register on each pass, calls an unnamed routine, and repeats while a bit of a shared flag word is set. It then clears that flag word; the port carries the fire-button and disk-status lines.

key: runtime segment $03B5E0-$03ED50 (ext):0:2EDA
name: pulse_port_and_count_down
description: If a shared counter is nonzero, writes a pair of byte values to the port, decrements the counter, and returns the result of an unnamed routine; otherwise it returns zero.

key: runtime segment $03B5E0-$03ED50 (ext):0:2EF6
name: hang_in_empty_loop
description: Enters an endless loop with no body, so it never returns to its caller. The raster-position register listed in its facts does not appear in the recovered code, which keeps only this unreachable loop.

key: runtime segment $03B5E0-$03ED50 (ext):0:2F16
name: advance_port_pulse_counter
description: While a shared counter has not reached its limit, writes a pair of byte values to the port, increments the counter, and calls an unnamed routine once. It returns without action once the limit is reached.

key: runtime segment $03B5E0-$03ED50 (ext):0:2F36
name: count_status_byte_passes
description: Counts passes of the high byte of a word in a record through the values 100 and 101, stopping after 300 counts or when bit one of another word in the record is set. It then writes a fixed control word into the record.

key: runtime segment $03B5E0-$03ED50 (ext):0:2F6A
name: return_stack_argument
description: Returns the eight bytes found at the top of the stack as its result, with no other effect.

key: runtime segment $03B5E0-$03ED50 (ext):0:3238
name: load_audio_channel_pointers
description: Advances a frame counter. On the wrap-around path it runs two countdown delays, copies eight stored words into the audio channel location registers, and scans a byte table until a counter returns to zero. Otherwise it calls three unnamed routines and jumps.

key: runtime segment $03B5E0-$03ED50 (ext):0:337E
name: process_tracker_channel_note
description: Reads one note cell for a sound channel. When it names a sample, it loads that sample's 30-byte table entry into the channel state and writes the channel's audio location and length registers. It then dispatches on the effect nibble to one of several command handlers.

key: runtime segment $03B5E0-$03ED50 (ext):0:354A
name: update_channel_period_compare
description: Masks a stored period word down to its low 12 bits and stores it as the current value. It then clears a flag byte: if the value equals the stored target it zeroes the current value, and if the value is below the target it sets the flag.

key: runtime segment $03B5E0-$03ED50 (ext):0:3628
name: apply_channel_tick_effect
description: Runs one per-tick effect on a sound channel, chosen by the low nibble of the effect word: a three-step arpeggio, a pitch slide down or up with clamping to fixed limits, a tone slide toward a target, a vibrato read from a lookup table, or a volume slide. The new period and volume are written to the channel state and returned.

name: store_pointer_and_trap
description: Stores the address of an unnamed routine in a global variable and then raises a system trap with no arguments. It returns nothing.

name: init_display_and_copper
description: Initialises the custom chips: it polls a status bit between steps, writes the copper list pointer and starts the copper, and sets DMA and interrupt control bits. It loops over a counter to clear a 64-entry table, then writes three saved words with their set bits raised to control registers.

name: copy_sixteen_words_to_block
description: Copies sixteen 16-bit words from a fixed source table into a block at a set offset from an address register, then returns.

name: empty_return_stub
description: Contains only a return and changes no memory or registers; it is an empty routine called once.

name: copy_table_on_button_step
description: When the mouse button bit is set, advances a step counter. At the stored limit it resets the counter, copies thirty-two 16-bit entries from one table to another while walking backward, and stores a saved word into the last slot.

name: build_copper_list_entries
description: Fills a copper list with thirty-three wait-and-move pairs, each waiting for a successive scan line and writing a value to a colour register. It then appends a fixed set of wait and move instructions and an end-of-list marker.

name: step_colors_toward_source
description: Walks a 32-entry colour source table. For each entry it moves a working 12-bit colour one step per red, green and blue nibble toward the source value and stores the result in a palette block, advancing the source index whenever the colour matches.

name: fill_bitplane_pointer_copper_list
description: Writes eight register-and-data word pairs into a fixed copper list area. The data words hold the high and low halves of each bitplane pointer, so the copper list will point the display at the bitplane memory.

name: interleave_three_source_planes
description: Copies three consecutive 2,120-byte source regions into three bitplanes that sit 8 KB apart, one byte at a time, in a single loop.

name: stash_fields_and_reset_limits
description: Copies three fields from a state record into globals, saves one more global, and sets three fields of another record to the maximum 16-bit value. It makes no other calls.

name: copy_block_to_second_buffer
description: Copies a fixed block of 179 bytes from one table into a second buffer, one byte at a time, then returns.

name: render_pending_text_line
description: On every eighteenth call, reads a zero-terminated text buffer and draws each character as six rows of glyph data from a font table into the bitmap, using a 40-byte row stride. A two-code moves to a new line, and zero ends the text.

name: clear_sixteen_words_block
description: Writes zero to sixteen consecutive 16-bit words in a block at a fixed offset from an address register, then returns.

name: clear_bitmap_region_bytes
description: Writes zero to about 40 kilobytes of consecutive bytes, one at a time, starting at a fixed location in bitmap memory.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(it)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(It)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:echo:0:0136
name: copy_header_words_then_call
description: If the destination pointer is set, copies sixteen 32-bit words from a fixed record into it, then calls a routine through a function pointer held in a register.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(it)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(It)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:intro.comp:0:0000
name: load_amigados_hunk_executable
description: Loads an AmigaDOS executable hunk by hunk: it allocates memory for each code and data hunk through the exec library, copies the hunk contents, and applies the 32-bit relocation records until the end-of-file marker. It finishes by storing a fixed result word when no memory was recorded.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(it)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(It)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:intro.comp:0:0138
name: spin_delay_countdown
description: Counts a 16-bit register down one step per pass as a fixed-length delay, then returns.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(it)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(It)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:intro.comp:0:017C
name: unpack_backward_bitstream_block
description: Unpacks a compressed block from its end toward its start: it reads a bit stream from the tail of the data and either copies literal bytes or repeats earlier output, writing downward until the output pointer reaches the start of the buffer.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(it)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(It)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:intro.comp:0:01C8
name: shift_bits_from_stream
description: Pulls a counted number of bits one at a time from a bit stream held in a word, refilling the stream from memory when it empties, and shifts them into an accumulator word. Three routines call it, and it reads its count from a register.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(it)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(It)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:intro.comp:0:021C
name: tiny_routine_pcrel_entry
description: Decompilation timed out, so only the listed facts are known: a three-instruction routine whose address is loaded pc-relative and which has a single caller. Its purpose cannot be determined from this evidence.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(it)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(It)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:another:0:0000
name: startup_timing_setup_wait
description: Startup routine that runs several setup calls, sets a timing value of 300 that becomes 2400 when a configuration bit is set, waits until a status bit clears, clears a counter, and then runs more setup calls.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(it)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(It)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:another:0:0066
name: dispatch_code_to_record_slots
description: Dispatches on a 16-bit code value, and for each recognised code marks two to four entries of a 20-byte record table and copies record fields for later use. It then resets a 128-entry word table to minus one and a 32-entry long table to zero, and loops over 64 entries updating them.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(it)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(It)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:another:0:006C
name: resume_code_slot_dispatch_loop
description: Loop variant of the same code dispatch: it resets the word and long tables, scans 64 entries, and dispatches on a 16-bit code value to mark record slots and copy their fields. It repeats until the code changes.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(it)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(It)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:another:0:012E
name: interpret_script_opcodes
description: Interprets a byte-coded script for a game engine: its opcodes assign, add, subtract, and bitwise-modify 16-bit variables, compare values for conditional jumps, call and return through a stack, and set table entries. The routine returns when the script halts or leaves its valid range.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(it)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(It)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:another:0:045A
name: branch_script_if_equal
description: Two-instruction entry that jumps into the shared script opcode loop when the zero flag is set, meaning the compared values were equal. The shown pseudo-code is the whole interpreter body because the decompiler merged it in.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(it)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(It)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:another:0:0462
name: branch_script_if_not_equal
description: Two-instruction entry that jumps into the shared script opcode loop when the zero flag is clear, meaning the compared values differed. The shown pseudo-code is the whole interpreter body because the decompiler merged it in.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(it)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(It)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:another:0:046A
name: branch_script_if_signed_greater
description: Two-instruction entry that jumps into the shared script opcode loop when the zero flag is clear and the negative and overflow flags agree, which is the signed greater-than test. The shown pseudo-code is the whole interpreter body because the decompiler merged it in.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(it)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(It)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:another:0:0472
name: branch_script_if_signed_ge
description: Two-instruction entry that jumps into the shared script opcode loop when the negative and overflow flags agree, which is the signed greater-or-equal test. The shown pseudo-code is the whole interpreter body because the decompiler merged it in.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(it)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(It)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:another:0:047A
name: branch_script_if_signed_less
description: Two-instruction entry that jumps into the shared script opcode loop when the negative and overflow flags differ, which is the signed less-than test. The shown pseudo-code is the whole interpreter body because the decompiler merged it in.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(it)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(It)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:another:0:0482
name: run_script_opcodes_signed_le
description: Second full copy of the script opcode interpreter, entered for a signed less-or-equal branch test. It executes the same opcode set, assigning, arithmetic, bitwise, comparison, and call and return operations, until the script halts.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(it)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(It)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:another:0:0654
name: process_shape_draw_command
description: Processes one drawing command from a shape stream: for the lower command range it returns, and otherwise it steps through a list of vertices, scaling each offset by a zoom value from a register and building the coordinates for the next step. It has three callers.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(it)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(It)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:another:0:0704
name: walk_entries_by_high_bit
description: Walks a counted list of entries with a three-word stride, testing the top bit of two words in each entry, and calls an unnamed routine for every entry that is visited. The count comes from a stack argument.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(it)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(It)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:another:0:0710
name: record_address_by_index
description: Returns the address of the twenty-byte record at the index held in a register, computed from the base of the record table.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(it)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(It)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:another:0:071C
name: print_text_entry_for_key
description: Scans a table of word-keyed entries for a matching key and, when one is found, reads the zero-terminated text that follows it, skipping carriage-return bytes and passing each character to an unnamed routine. It returns without action when no entry matches.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(it)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(It)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:another:0:075E
name: draw_eight_row_tile_bounded
description: Checks that a screen position lies inside a 40-by-193 area, then combines eight pattern rows into the bitmap using OR or AND-NOT, chosen by a bit of a mode word.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(it)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(It)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:another:0:07DA
name: decode_bitstream_into_buffer
description: Decodes a packed bit stream into a destination buffer. It shifts bits out of a word, refilling from memory when a marker bit runs out, and writes a byte for each decoded symbol.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(it)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(It)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:another:0:088A
name: shift_bit_window_right
description: Shifts a 32-bit bit window right by a counted number of positions, refilling its top bit from memory whenever the window empties. It returns nothing.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(it)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(It)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:another:0:08AA
name: select_highest_priority_object
description: Scans a table of twenty-byte records for entries of type two and keeps the one with the highest priority byte, stopping at the end marker. It then processes that record, or returns when none qualifies.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(it)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(It)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:another:0:09B4
name: format_word_as_text_digits
description: Converts a 16-bit value into four text characters, one per nibble from the top, using digit or letter characters, and returns the last character.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(it)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(It)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:another:0:09E6
name: mark_objects_until_budget_spent
description: Repeatedly picks the highest-priority record in a twenty-byte table whose type is three and whose sign bit matches a flag, marks it as type four, and subtracts its extent from a budget, stopping when no candidate is left. The budget is taken from one of two stored values.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(it)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(It)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:another:0:0A48
name: mark_chain_within_budget
description: Marks a given record as type four and subtracts its extent from a budget, then keeps selecting the next type-three record with the same flag until the budget goes negative or no candidate remains.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(it)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(It)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:another:0:0A68
name: move_marked_records_by_offset
description: Walks the twenty-byte record table and, for each record of type four, calls an unnamed routine and subtracts the returned offset from one of two stored values, chosen by the record's sign bit.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(it)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(It)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:another:0:0AA6
name: step_marked_records_by_delta
description: Subtracts a delta from one stored value, then walks the record table for type-four records, subtracting an unnamed routine's result from the other stored value until a sign-bit condition ends the walk.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(it)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(It)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:another:0:0AB4
name: return_stack_value_stub
description: Returns an eight-byte value taken from the stack, with no other effect.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(it)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(It)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:another:0:0ABA
name: copy_words_to_gap_count
description: Copies words from a source buffer to a destination for a count derived from the gap between a source pointer and one of two stored values.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(it)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(It)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:another:0:0ADC
name: copy_words_counted_loop
description: Copies words one at a time from a source to a destination, with the count held in a register and decremented until it passes below zero. It returns a stack argument unchanged.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(it)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(It)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:another:0:0AE6
name: copy_large_block_repeatedly
description: Copies 32,768 longwords, about 128 KB, from a source to a destination in a loop, repeated for a count taken from a register.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(it)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(It)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:another:0:0B1C
name: pass_stack_value_through
description: Returns an eight-byte value taken from the stack, with no other effect. It is a stub that the decompiler could not complete.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(it)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(It)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:another:0:0B22
name: dispatch_code_record_slots_alt
description: Second copy of the 16-bit code dispatcher. It clears the record slots, resets two stored indexes, and for a fixed set of codes marks two to four twenty-byte entries and copies their fields. It also resets the word and long tables.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(it)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(It)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:another:0:0C9E
name: clear_out_of_range_records
description: Walks the twenty-byte record table and zeroes the first byte of every record whose type lies outside the range three to six. It then restores two stored values from backup copies.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(it)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(It)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:another:0:0CE4
name: clear_all_records_restore_values
description: Zeroes the first byte of every twenty-byte record in the table, counting down a stored record count, then restores two stored values from backup copies.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(it)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(It)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:another:0:0D1A
name: count_records_until_sentinel
description: Counts twenty-byte records in the table until a sentinel word of minus one is reached, and stores the count minus one in a stored value.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(it)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(It)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:another:0:37B8
name: draw_line_with_blitter
description: Sets up the Amiga blitter to draw a line between two screen points on a 40-byte-per-row bitmap. It swaps the endpoints when a flag is set, derives the major and minor deltas and octant bits, and starts the blitter with line-mode control values, using a fallback area at the bottom edge.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(it)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(It)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:another:0:38D2
name: clip_line_then_draw
description: Clips a line segment against the screen bounds using edge outcode flags, stores the clipped endpoints, and then calls the line-drawing routine. It returns without drawing when both endpoints lie outside the same edge.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(it)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(It)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:another:0:3A24
name: return_only_stub
description: Contains only a return, so it changes no memory or registers. It is a call target that the recovered code never fills in.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(it)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(It)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:another:0:3A50
name: subdivide_segment_at_midpoint
description: Recursively splits a line segment at its midpoint, returning when the midpoint equals an endpoint, and calls an unnamed routine for each piece. It stops early when a mask test on an accumulated flag fails.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(it)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(It)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:another:0:3AE6
name: draw_polygon_outline_from_vertices
description: Reads a byte-coded vertex list, scales each vertex by a zoom value, and steps along the polygon edges. It calls the line-drawing routine for each edge while tracking the top and bottom scan lines.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(it)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(It)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:another:0:3C00
name: fill_polygon_spans_with_blitter
description: Fills the spans of a polygon scanline by scanline. It tracks the active edges, writes word masks to the blitter data registers for each span, and uses the first-word mask register for the leftmost word.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(it)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(It)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:another:0:3F7C
name: init_object_record_fields
description: Fills a block of record fields from its parameters: sets one value and a two-count, clears two fields to the maximum word, copies two longwords, and writes a shared value to four further word fields.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(it)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(It)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:another:0:3FBA
name: wait_for_blitter_idle
description: Polls the blitter busy bit in the DMA status register until the blitter is idle, then returns.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(it)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(It)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:another:0:3FCA
name: decode_joystick_direction_flags
description: Reads the joystick movement register and the fire-button port, combines them with a stored input word into direction and button flags, and stores the result in a state record. The direction bits are derived with an XOR-shift of the input.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(it)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(It)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:another:0:4068
name: copy_four_longwords_to_globals
description: Copies four 32-bit values from the pointed-to record into four global variables and returns.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(it)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(It)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:another:0:4084
name: scale_small_value_by_sixteen
description: Returns the input word unchanged when it is above three; otherwise it returns the word multiplied by sixteen.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(it)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(It)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:another:0:40B8
name: empty_routine_no_effect
description: Contains only a return, so it changes no memory or registers. It is called by one routine.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(it)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(It)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:another:0:40EC
name: draw_clipped_sprite_object
description: Checks that a sprite object lies within a 320-by-200 screen, clips its top and bottom rows, and draws its columns through a per-mode routine with a bit shift for horizontal position. It loops over the object's rows.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(it)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(It)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:another:0:42D0
name: mask_four_word_targets
description: ANDs four 16-bit words, each reached through its own pointer register, with a mask value, clearing every bit not set in the mask.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(it)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(It)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:another:0:42DA
name: mask_three_words_return_code
description: ANDs three 16-bit words, each reached through a pointer register, with a mask value. It returns a byte with a fixed bit set.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(it)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(It)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:another:0:4484
name: or_inverted_word_into_planes
description: Walks up to four stored plane pointers, and for each bit of a mask value that is set it ORs an inverted word into the plane word at a fixed offset, looping for the plane count.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(it)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(It)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:another:0:45BC
name: allocate_memory_or_fail
description: Calls the exec library's memory allocation routine through its vector and returns minus one when the result is a null pointer.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(it)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(It)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:another:0:45DA
name: free_memory_or_fail
description: Calls the exec library's memory-free routine through its vector and returns minus one when the call result is zero.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(it)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(It)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:another:0:45FA
name: queue_row_draw_commands
description: Builds draw-command records for a span of screen rows. For each row it writes fixed mode and mask words and row and column offsets derived from the vertical position, and it returns when the loop finishes.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(it)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(It)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:another:0:4716
name: apply_bit_mask_four_words
description: Checks four bits of a mask value in turn and calls an unnamed routine for each, passing a full or zero word, which sets or clears one of four stored words.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(it)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(It)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:another:0:477C
name: switch_display_mode_copper
description: Switches the display for a mode code. A sentinel code takes one path, while the other codes set up colour registers and a copper list, wait on the raster position, and then restart the copper and DMA.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(it)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(It)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:another:0:4950
name: set_display_window_for_mode
description: Chooses one of several display window and fetch setting sets from a rotated mode byte, writes the window, fetch, and control registers for that set, and clears three stored values.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(it)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(It)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:another:0:49A4
name: set_default_display_window
description: Writes the default display window, data fetch, and control registers, clears four control words and one stored value, and returns.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(it)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(It)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:another:0:4A22
name: set_display_window_variant
description: Writes the display window, data fetch, and control registers using a control word that differs from the default setup in one bit. It also clears four control words and one stored value.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(it)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(It)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:another:0:4A46
name: clear_display_control_words
description: Clears four display-control words in the block, along with one stored value, and returns.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(it)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(It)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:another:0:4A82
name: set_scroll_extents_forty
description: Zeroes two control words, sets two others to forty, and sets a stored flag to one. The serial data register listed in its facts does not appear in the shown code.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(it)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(It)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:another:0:4AF2
name: reset_input_state_from_table
description: Sets one stored word to all ones, copies the low byte of a table entry into another stored value, and clears a third. The serial data register listed in its facts is not read in the shown code.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(it)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(It)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:another:0:4B62
name: wait_for_raster_line
description: Polls the vertical position register until the raster reaches a fixed line, then returns its input value unchanged.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(it)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(It)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:another:0:4B84
name: control_dma_channels_undecoded
description: Writes the DMA control register, where a set top bit enables the channels named in the write. The decompiler timed out, so the exact channel mask and call sequence are not recovered from the code.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(it)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(It)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:another:0:4C50
name: lookup_record_when_code_matches
description: If its first argument is zero, stores a second argument into a global and returns. Otherwise it looks up a record and, when the record's type field matches a fixed code, calls an unnamed routine and stores the result.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(it)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(It)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:another:0:4CBC
name: open_ciaa_and_fill_table
description: Fills a fifteen-entry table with longwords from matching records, zeroing entries that do not match. On first use it opens the ciaa resource through the exec library and returns a flag for whether that call succeeded.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(it)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(It)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:another:0:4D4C
name: close_ciaa_resource_if_open
description: If the ciaa resource is marked open, calls the exec library's close routine through its vector and clears the open flag.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(it)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(It)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:another:0:4D96
name: write_ciaa_control_register
description: Writes a fixed control value to the CIA-A control register A, then copies a stored byte into a global variable.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(it)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(It)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:another:0:4D9E
name: copy_stored_timer_value
description: Copies a stored value into a global variable. The facts list the CIA-A timer A high and low registers, but the shown code only performs the copy.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(it)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(It)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:another:0:4DB6
name: clear_table_entry_fields
description: Walks a fifteen-entry pointer table and zeroes the longword at offset eight of each non-null record.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(it)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(It)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:another:0:4DCE
name: silence_audio_channels
description: Sets the volume register of each of the four audio channels to zero, then clears two stored values.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(it)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(It)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:another:0:4DF2
name: silence_audio_channels_set_flag
description: Sets the volume register of each of the four audio channels to zero, then sets a stored value to fifteen.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(it)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(It)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:another:0:4E10
name: call_routine_return_zero
description: Calls an unnamed routine and returns zero. It is referenced from data as a handler.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(it)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(It)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:another:0:4E18
name: cycle_audio_channel_setup
description: Advances a six-step counter. On each step before the last it calls an unnamed routine for each of the four audio channel register blocks, counting the channel index down, and on the sixth step it resets the counter.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(it)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(It)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:another:0:4E3C
name: run_routine_per_audio_channel
description: Calls an unnamed routine once for each of the four audio channel register blocks, counting the channel index down, and returns the stack argument unchanged. The first block it visits is the one listed in its facts.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(it)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(It)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:another:0:4E70
name: update_channel_envelope_step
description: For one sound channel, adds a signed step to a level word and clamps it against a limit, or follows the complementary path, then passes the result to an unnamed routine. The sign of the first word selects which path runs.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(it)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(It)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:another:0:4E92
name: clamp_add_channel_level
description: Adds an input delta to a stored level word, raises the result to a floor value when it falls below that floor, and writes the result to two destinations.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(it)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(It)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:another:0:4EA6
name: dispatch_channel_effect_table
description: Reads the low nibble of a channel control word and, for values of one or seven, dispatches through a jump table of routines indexed by a counter. The decompiler could not recover that table, so the other branches are only partly known.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(it)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(It)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:another:0:4EC4
name: init_channel_state_from_table
description: Initialises a channel state record from a sound command: clears its first word, stores the command value and a four-bit field, then searches a sentinel-terminated table for the value and stores the matching index.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(it)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(It)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:another:0:4EFE
name: store_signed_table_offset
description: Stores one table entry into a fixed record field, choosing the table index as twice an input index or its negative according to a flag.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(it)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(It)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:another:0:4F10
name: store_word_into_record_field
description: Stores a 16-bit input value into the fourth word of a record.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(it)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(It)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:another:0:4F16
name: init_channel_record_with_sign
description: Initialises a channel record: clears its first word, stores a value and a four-bit field with the sign taken from the control word, then looks the value up in a sentinel-terminated table.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(it)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(It)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:another:0:4F1A
name: dispatch_through_handler_table
description: Calls one of several handler routines chosen by a counter through a pointer table. The decompiler could not recover the table, so the full handler set is not listed.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(it)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(It)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:another:0:4F52
name: lookup_table_entry_by_key
description: Finds the position of a record's key in a word table, then copies the entry at a register-supplied index into a record field.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(it)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(It)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:another:0:4F6C
name: lookup_entry_by_high_nibble
description: Finds the position of a record's key in a word table, then copies the entry at the index given by the high nibble of a control byte into a record field.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(it)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(It)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:another:0:4F76
name: lookup_entry_by_low_nibble
description: Finds the position of a record's key in a word table, then copies the entry at the index given by the low nibble of a control byte into a record field.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(it)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(It)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:another:0:4F82
name: copy_record_word_to_field
description: Copies a 16-bit word from a fixed offset in a record into another field of the same record.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(it)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(It)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:another:0:4F8C
name: start_audio_dma_channels
description: Starts the four audio channels: clears a channel-enable word, runs an unnamed routine for each channel, sets the DMA enable bit, waits a short delay, then loads the audio location registers from the channel table.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(it)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(It)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:another:0:5078
name: update_channel_note_entry
description: Resets a channel record's first two words and, when a flag is set, reads a sample pointer into it. When the channel's nibble is nonzero it looks up a table entry and calls two unnamed routines to set the length and period.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(it)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(It)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:another:0:50E8
name: step_channel_volume_envelope
description: Sets a channel's flag and step fields, then adjusts the volume level by the parameter. Mode five adds and clamps at sixty-four, and mode six subtracts and clamps at zero.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(it)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(It)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:another:0:5124
name: set_channel_level_with_marker
description: Adds a parameter to a channel level and clamps the result at sixty-four before storing it. A special marker value in the channel record stores one field into a global and clears it, while other nonzero records take the normal path.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(it)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(It)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:another:0:5156
name: trigger_channel_sample_start
description: For an active channel record, clears its flag, copies its sample fields, waits a short delay, then zeroes or sets the length according to the record's marker value. The DMA control register is listed in its facts.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(it)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(It)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:another:0:5184
name: copy_channel_sample_fields
description: Copies a longword and two words from a channel record into the output block, and ORs the record's flag word into a running mask.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(it)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(It)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:another:0:5344
name: fill_bitplanes_by_mask
description: For each of four bitplanes, fills a block of 8,000 longwords with all ones or all zeros according to one bit of an input mask.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(it)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(It)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:another:0:5376
name: lock_df0_volume_as_current
description: Releases any previous DOS lock, waits on a serial input code, pauses briefly, then locks the DF0 volume through the DOS library and makes it the current directory, storing the lock or closing it when the lock fails.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(it)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(It)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:another:0:5472
name: wait_for_disk_status_clear
description: Polls the disk-status bit in the CIA port register until it clears, then calls an unnamed routine.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(it)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(It)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:another:0:54B6
name: load_dos_file_blitter_owned
description: Opens a disk file through the DOS library, seeks and reads its contents while multitasking is forbidden and the blitter is owned, then closes the file, releases the blitter, and re-enables multitasking.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(it)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(It)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:another:0:55B0
name: call_library_pair_and_compare
description: Calls two library routines, then when a flag byte is set and a stack argument differs from the second parameter, calls an unnamed routine. It returns the stack argument, with a result of minus one unless that path is taken.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(it)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(It)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:another:0:55C0
name: fill_color_register_delay
description: Writes a colour value to the background colour register in a nested countdown loop, using the repeated writes as a timed colour pulse. It is called by six routines.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(it)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(It)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:another:0:55E2
name: delay_then_zero_block
description: Runs one long countdown loop, then writes zero to 4,096 consecutive locations. It is called by seven routines, some through a handler pointer, and writes the background colour register as well.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(it)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(It)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:another:0:560C
name: allocate_buffers_open_libs
description: Opens the DOS and graphics libraries, reads the free memory size, and lays out a set of buffers spaced 8,000 bytes apart, storing their pointers in globals. It then derives several buffer offsets from the allocations it obtains.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(it)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(It)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:another:0:57E6
name: toggle_dma_channel_bits
description: Writes a DMA control value that clears one group of channel bits, then writes a second value that sets another group with the enable bit.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(it)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(It)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:another:0:5808
name: register_interrupt_server_node
description: Allocates an interrupt node through a library vector, fills in its data pointer, a priority of one hundred, a type code of two, and a handler routine, then registers the node through the exec library.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(it)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(It)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:another:0:585E
name: forbid_and_own_blitter
description: Disables multitasking through the exec library and claims the blitter through the graphics library.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(it)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(It)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:another:0:5874
name: permit_and_disown_blitter
description: Releases the blitter through the graphics library and re-enables multitasking through the exec library.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(it)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(It)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:another:0:588A
name: start_copper_list_from_struct
description: Loads the copper list pointer from a field of a stored structure, clears a related register, and enables copper DMA by writing the set bit to the DMA control register.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(it)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(It)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:another:0:58A8
name: call_four_routines_return_zero
description: Calls four unnamed routines in sequence and returns zero.

key: FirstSamurai_v1.5_1182/FirstSamurai/FirstSamurai.slave:0:0062
name: patch_code_when_check_matches
description: Calls a routine and compares its result with a fixed check value. When they match, it writes a set of instruction words into the code area, including absolute jump and branch words, and stores a routine address in one of them.

key: FirstSamurai_v1.5_1182/FirstSamurai/FirstSamurai.slave:0:0142
name: write_patch_instruction_block
description: Writes a fixed run of instruction words, including absolute jump words and a stored routine address, into memory at a computed location.

key: FirstSamurai_v1.5_1182/FirstSamurai/FirstSamurai.slave:0:01CC
name: install_call_hook_fill_table
description: Writes an absolute call instruction word followed by an unnamed routine's address into a fixed memory location, then fills a table with a 128-step loop.

key: FirstSamurai_v1.5_1182/FirstSamurai/FirstSamurai.slave:0:01E4
name: copy_byte_field_to_word
description: Copies a byte from one record into a word field of another record, then returns its first argument unchanged.

key: FirstSamurai_v1.5_1182/FirstSamurai/FirstSamurai.slave:0:01F4
name: write_jump_block_with_prompt
description: Writes a sequence of jump and branch instruction words into memory, and its facts reference the text Press fire. The decompiler reports bad instruction data in the flow, so only the writes are reliably recovered.

key: FirstSamurai_v1.5_1182/FirstSamurai/FirstSamurai.slave:0:026E
name: write_call_instruction_stub
description: Writes an absolute call instruction word and an unnamed routine's address into memory. The decompiled flow ends at a bad-instruction marker, so only that write is reliable.

key: FirstSamurai_v1.5_1182/FirstSamurai/FirstSamurai.slave:0:0286
name: install_call_patches_at_offsets
description: Writes an absolute jump word, then a series of absolute call words at fixed offsets within a code block, each pointing to the same low address. It calls four unnamed routines.

key: FirstSamurai_v1.5_1182/FirstSamurai/FirstSamurai.slave:0:03AC
name: patch_call_and_bounds_trap
description: Writes a patch byte and an absolute call word into memory, then traps when an index is negative or exceeds a bound read through a pointer. The decompiled flow stops at a bad-instruction marker.

key: FirstSamurai_v1.5_1182/FirstSamurai/FirstSamurai.slave:0:03D0
name: return_patch_if_signature_matches
description: Checks four words in memory against a fixed signature, and when all four match it overwrites the first word with a return instruction and stores a hardware base value.

key: FirstSamurai_v1.5_1182/FirstSamurai/FirstSamurai.slave:0:0414
name: set_field_then_wait_blitter
description: Stores a word into a field of a structure, then polls the blitter busy bit in the DMA status register until the blitter is idle.

key: FirstSamurai_v1.5_1182/FirstSamurai/FirstSamurai.slave:0:043C
name: store_field_then_wait_blitter
description: Stores a word into a field of a structure, then polls the blitter busy bit in the DMA status register until the blitter is idle.

key: FirstSamurai_v1.5_1182/FirstSamurai/FirstSamurai.slave:0:0442
name: store_block_values_on_match
description: Checks whether a byte, rotated one bit, equals a fixed key, and if so stores four configuration words for a block. The code is the same as a neighbouring routine in this file.

key: FirstSamurai_v1.5_1182/FirstSamurai/FirstSamurai.slave:0:046E
name: store_block_values_match_b
description: Checks whether a byte, rotated one bit, equals a fixed key, and if so stores four configuration words for a block. The code is the same as a neighbouring routine in this file.

key: FirstSamurai_v1.5_1182/FirstSamurai/FirstSamurai.slave:0:049A
name: dispatch_on_flag_bits
description: Tests bit zero of a flag word. When it is set, the routine calls a handler through a table entry; when it is clear, it calls an unnamed routine and calls one more if bit four is also set. It passes its return value through.

key: FirstSamurai_v1.5_1182/FirstSamurai/FirstSamurai.slave:0:04EC
name: dispatch_on_flag_bits_variant
description: Tests bit zero of a flag word. When it is set, the routine calls a handler through a table entry; when it is clear, it calls an unnamed routine and calls one more if bit four is also set. It passes its return value through.

key: FirstSamurai_v1.5_1182/FirstSamurai/FirstSamurai.slave:0:052A
name: call_table_entry_passthrough
description: Calls a routine through a fixed table entry and returns its result pair unchanged.

key: FirstSamurai_v1.5_1182/FirstSamurai/Disk.1:bootblock:0:000C
name: boot_block_allocate_and_read
description: Boot block entry: runs a countdown that flashes the background colour, allocates a buffer, then issues repeated 1,024-byte read requests through the exec I/O routine until the transfer completes, and ends with a motor-off request. It returns zero on success and a failure code when allocation fails.

name: tiny_undecoded_entry_stub
description: Decompilation timed out, so only the facts are known: a three-instruction entry that is executed once and makes one call to an unnamed routine. Its purpose cannot be determined from this evidence.

key: Disk.1 +$400 loaded at $040000 (4608 bytes):0:000A
name: disk_drive_port_undecoded
description: Decompilation timed out, so only the facts are known: a 27-instruction routine that touches the CIA-B port B register and the DMA control register, makes three calls, and is reached through a tiny relay. The exact sequence of writes is not recovered.

name: undecoded_eight_instruction_routine
description: Decompilation timed out, so only the facts are known: an eight-instruction routine whose address is taken pc-relative, called by one routine and making one call to an unnamed routine. Its purpose cannot be determined from this evidence.

key: Disk.1 +$400 loaded at $040000 (4608 bytes):0:00A8
name: undecoded_six_instruction_routine
description: Decompilation timed out, so only the facts are known: a six-instruction routine whose address is taken pc-relative and which has one caller. Its purpose cannot be determined from this evidence.

key: Disk.1 +$400 loaded at $040000 (4608 bytes):0:00BA
name: startup_reset_and_decode_block
description: Start-up routine that clears audio and sprite registers and fills the low vector table with a sentinel value. It then XOR-decodes a 192-byte block with a key that rotates five bits each step, and halts through an error path when a size check fails.

key: Disk.1 +$400 loaded at $040000 (4608 bytes):0:00BE
name: relocate_counted_longword_blocks
description: Copies a counted block of longwords to a fixed low work address, then copies further blocks to other addresses when their size values are nonzero.

key: Disk.1 +$400 loaded at $040000 (4608 bytes):0:00C6
name: place_record_on_eleven_grid
description: Converts a position into grid coordinates by dividing by eleven and storing the quotient and remainder in the record, doubling the quotient when a flag bit is set. It checks bounds first and returns an error code when they fail, otherwise it continues into a per-step loop.

key: Disk.1 +$400 loaded at $040000 (4608 bytes):0:00CA
